introduction: Explore the undead herders’ tunnels, return stolen lives and proofs, and choose which bonesmith services to pursue. Six independent story requests and six services use exact materials. New discovery and progress require active, ready accounting.
orientation: Enter from the Burnt Plains of a Fallen Realm or the Rocky Foothills of the Black Mountains. The deep tunnel also connects to the upper Underdark. Water currents, the Demon Well and hostile inhabitants make travel dangerous; the journal does not remove those risks.

PULL either fixed crank to open its blocked tunnel route. PUSH the boulder to reach the dragon’s approach, and PUSH the unfinished statue to reveal the later passage. These controls change shared access: seeing an open route does not prove you operated it.

The lich dark wizard beside Zugle holds the wand with a black gem. Bring that exact wand to the brutalized gnome. He leaves after the accepted rescue and awards experience. Using a wand, owning a similar wand or defeating the lich does not itself record the rescue.

The bone abomination carries the small bone key for Argle’s office. UNLOCK and OPEN the office door when needed. Argle offers five bonesmith recipes; the imprisoned gnome offers the sixth service. Those crafts remain outside story achievement and daily credit.

Blood-smeared sleeves and leggings come from the undead shopkeeper. Search bone piles or the corpse pile for small fragments and large bones. The fomorian giant also carries a large bone. Tiny scales belong to the tiny dragonkin following the short necromancer, rather than the necromancer’s own inventory. Remove hidden ingredients from containers before offering them.

The small leather eyepatch is hidden inside the halfling corpse in the secluded alcove. Argle asks for the eyepatch and three tiny dragonkin scales. His finished eyepatch describes ten scales, but the accepted recipe requires three.

Argle’s four recipes with copper fees are currently unavailable while accounting is active. Keep their advertised materials and fees visible as service guidance; supplying materials or coins does not create a completed craft. Do not spend a different recipe’s material expecting it to count twice.

To aid the nereid shade, PUSH the boulder and seek the ancient two-headed black dragon for the foreign lifeforce. This material does not survive ordinary rent/save handling; do not assume it will still be available after reconnecting. Return the actual lifeforce for a magical crystal and the shade’s departure. Her response describes restoration, without recording a separate escort or healing action.

Drakasyth’s revenge request needs both Archazel’s huge bone broadsword and Viscerith’s tainted soul. Viscerith does not always carry the soul. Desecration, the reward, is a different sword and cannot replace the requested broadsword. Supplied matching proofs work without your own kills.

Drakasyth’s second request needs five undead beholder central eyes together. The five beholders in the royal stronghold carry the eyes; they are not CARVE rewards. Zugle’s plain diorite key opens the serpent chamber, and the serpent’s enchanted key opens the royal route. Stronghold golems carry a further key. One locked stronghold door has a mismatched reverse key: qualify your return route before relying on it.

The guardian hellbeast wears the collar that serves as the key to the last cell. Remove it before using it as a loose key. Persevesk holds the beaten grey elf infant there, beside the bound grey elf prisoner Pearls. Give the exact infant to the prisoner for the rescue and experience award. The response’s cutting, healing and departure are not additional required player actions.

For the tall vampire warlock, ENTER the fixed dark rift to reach the keymaster; DOWN returns. His held key unlocks the two spires. The northern entrance leads to the right mind half and the southern entrance to the left. Bring one of each: two copies of either half will not satisfy the request. The warlock leaves after the accepted exchange for fangs.

The imprisoned gnome carver exchanges the same diorite scales used for Argle’s boots for a diorite warlord statue. He remains after the craft. His prisoner description does not make this recipe a rescue; PUSH the unfinished statue is a separate shared access control.

Shaenae the Mystic in Fenaline owns the request for the aged silver ring found in the Bone Yard’s stock. That foreign hand-in awards experience and copper, and remains in Fenaline’s journal. The silver stud is a different item. Finding a ring here does not complete Shaenae’s request.

ENTER the fixed pool of blood to reach its hidden tunnel; UP returns. Shops, the inn, buried-looking props, unbound prisoner and monster lore, and Archazel’s epic training are separate from these six story requests. Training has its own class, race, level and payment restrictions and is unavailable under active accounting.

All six story requests are potential dailies under current rules. Availability depends on current materials, legitimate item supply and the return of givers who leave. The quests can be completed independently; a matching gift does not require earlier personal kills, travel, or another story receipt.

contacts.name: a flaming skeleton highlord
contacts.description: In the first warlord group: greeting yields a refusal, without a quest reward.

contacts.name: Zugle, wight warlord
contacts.description: Carries the plain diorite key. Ask about Viscerith for the former mount’s history.

contacts.name: a lich dark wizard
contacts.description: Beside Zugle: holds the black-gem wand; ask about riders, the flaming horde or the pyrobeast.

contacts.name: a brutalized gnome
contacts.description: Beside Zugle: accepts the black-gem wand and leaves after the rescue.

contacts.name: an ancient vampiric behemoth
contacts.description: The ancient behemoth beside Zugle responds to greetings with a public growl.

contacts.name: Argle, the Bonesmith
contacts.description: In his locked office: five bonesmith services. Ask about sleeves, leggings, eyepatch, armor, diorite or boots.

contacts.name: a lich warlock
contacts.description: The lich warlock explains Zugle’s mount. Topic replies are lore, without a separate completion.

contacts.name: Archazel
contacts.description: Wields the huge bone broadsword requested by Drakasyth. His choke response is public; epic training is a separate guarded service.

contacts.name: the shade of a nereid
contacts.description: The nereid shade accepts the foreign lifeforce for a crystal and leaves.

contacts.name: Drakasyth
contacts.description: In the mist caves: offers revenge and five-eye requests. The Archazel topic has a public response.

contacts.name: a flaming skeleton highlord
contacts.description: The later flaming highlord refuses greetings; no additional story outcome.

contacts.name: a flaming skeleton warrior
contacts.description: The flaming warrior refuses greetings; no additional story outcome.

contacts.name: a bound and gagged grey elf prisoner
contacts.description: Pearls, in the last cell with Persevesk: accepts the beaten grey elf infant and leaves after the rescue.

contacts.name: a tall vampire warlock
contacts.description: The tall vampire warlock asks for the two distinct farseer mind halves and leaves after accepting them.

contacts.name: an imprisoned gnome stone carver
contacts.description: The imprisoned carver exchanges diorite scales for a statue and remains; his craft is a service.
